description: Variation of condition 2 of reference 26/01602/FUL to allow the addition of a window to the left side elevation of the building.
decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with 25.06.2026 (the date of the decision notice of planning application reference 26/01602/FUL)Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 (Section 73 applications cannot vary the original time limit).

For the purposes of this decision, condition 2 of planning permission 26/00772/FUL shall be replaced with the following condition:The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:EE00P 00 REV C P 01 REV CP 02 REV CP 04 REV CP 05 REV CP 06 REV CReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Prior to first occupation of the HMO, Cycle parking, shall be provided as indicated on drawing P05 REV C, in accordance with the following requirements:- Provision of a minimum of Eight long stay cycle parking spaces;- in an accessible location; the store door must have a minimum opening width of 1.2m- long stay cycle parking spaces secured with a British Standard mortice lock or access fob;- fully enclosed: 4 walls and a roof.Reason: To ensure the provision of accessible, secure, and adequate cycle parking facilities and to safeguard the character and appearance of the area.

Prior to occupation of the development, the refuse storage facilities shown on drawing number P06 REV C shall be provided in accordance with the approved details and maintained as such thereafter.Reason: In the interests of amenity and the recycling of waste materials in support of the Boroughs waste reduction targets.

The use of the property as a House in Multiple Occupation hereby approved shall be occupied by a maximum of 8 people at any one time and shall not be subdivided or occupied as self-contained units. Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.

Prior to occupation of the development details of the proposed means of enclosure for the front of the site shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved means of enclosure shall be installed  in accordance with the approved detail prior to occupation of the development and shall thereafter be retained as approved.Reason: To ensure satisfactory appearance and safeguard the privacy, amenity and safety of adjoining occupiers and the public and in the interests of highway safety.This condition was discharged under 26/01806/CND

No cooking facilities, including hot plates, shall be installed in the bedrooms of the development hereby permitted unless details have first been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Any cooking facilities shall thereafter only be implemented in accordance with the details that have been approved pursuant to this condition.Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.

The glazing serving the additional side window at ground floor, as seen along the proposed side elevation of the development shall be in obscured glass with an equivalent obscuration as level 3 on the Pilkington Obscuration Range and the window shall be non-opening unless the parts of the window which can be opened are more than 1.7 metres above the floor of the room in which the window is installed. The glazing shall not be altered without the approval in writing of the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To safeguard the privacy of the occupiers of adjoining and neighbouring properties
